name: Ayuntamiento de Benahavis
verdict: The town council of Benahavís (Málaga) sponsoring in its own name; a Spanish municipal government with no record of serious abuses found.
note: Proposed none 2026-09-28 (issue #340): the sponsor is the council itself (NIF P2902300I on benahavis.es). State ownership alone is not a tier; no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the Ayuntamiento de Benahavís was found, so nothing found.
